text:
mike: Quick pre-cutoff check: are we good on deps + lockfile bump for the release? Cutoff is tomorrow 10:00 PT. I have a submodule stash (GPU-quant-opt) I need to fold into a dep PR; don't want it to block.

anna: Started vendor sync earlier — found drift in go.mod and yarn.lock. Opened PR https://git.internal/r/redwood/pulls/6321. CI failed on mac-asan flake, rerunning. :eyes:

sam: Link to PR appreciated. Local steps I ran:
```
git fetch origin
git checkout -b deps/vendor-sync-2025
git submodule update --init --recursive
./scripts/vendor.sh
```
CI triggered with `ci/deps-sync` job.

rahul: If you un-stash submodules, use:
```
git submodule update --remote --merge
```
Also double-check `scripts/prune_vendor.sh` — we had extra files causing image bloat. Note: kvcache quantize change required a header bump in third_party/quant.

liz: Strong request: only include security fixes or release blockers in this bump. Anything aesthetic can wait post-cutoff. Please add changelog snippets to `docs/changelog/unreleased.md` so release notes aren't an afterthought. :memo:

mike: @anna @rahul if CI keeps flaking, can we cherry-pick the lockfile change to a separate PR to unblock? I can take the backport.

anna: Yes. I'll split lockfile -> #6322 and keep the submodule patches in #6321. Will mark #6322 as high-priority and add reviewers @sam @rahul.

release-bot: Cutoff reminder: release window opens 2025-03-18T17:00Z — last non-critical merges should land by 2025-03-18T16:00Z. Auto-merge disabled inside window.

sam: Quick checklist I'm following:
- split lockfile commit (done -> #6322)
- vendor prune + lint (running)
- run `make test-short` locally
- trigger `ci/deps-sync` and `ci/release-smoke`

rahul: Also please run the docker build locally after vendor sync: `DOCKER_BUILDKIT=1 make image` — we've had subtle file-perms issues when vendor dirs change.

liz: Ping me once #6322 is green; I'll add the changelog badge and queue for the release candidate.

mike: Thanks all — I'll hold off unstashing until #6322 lands. If someone else needs to land submodule work, please coordinate here. :thumbsup:
